scripts.title: LARPHUB: EASY COMBO, EASY, NO KEY
scripts.features:
Universal Showdown | Lock-On Orbit V1
READ THIS:

this script sends a webhook to discord when you run it. username, userid, game name, placeid, jobid. the script literally pops up a warning telling you this before it continues so dont act surprised. there's a feedback webhook too if you use the support tab.

lock on script for battlegrounds games. keeps you stuck to whoever you're fighting.

what it does

targeting:

auto picks targets (smart sorting or just nearest, your choice)

orbit weld so you stay glued to them

under-victim mode where you sit below them facing up so their swings go over your head, or behind mode if you turn that off

cycle targets, go back to previous, clear target

combat:

autocombo (auto M1)

auto Q when they get low

hit assist teleports you right in front so you actually hit

Q has its own weld offset

retreats if you get grabbed or take too much damage

defense:

antifling/antivoid

auto parks you when you're getting jumped or low

teamer detection, parks if 3+ people are looking at you

particle detection so it dips when they pop an aura

manual recovery key if you wanna park yourself

force respawn button

fling:

fling target key/button

walkfling if you want it to auto fling when you move

ui

hub gui you can drag and resize, 5 tabs

hud with target hp and what its doing

sidebar with fps/ping/kills

notifications

everything is rebindable except WASD F G B Q cause those are used for movement

keys
O = stop
C = cancel Q
M = recovery
1-4 = Q alts
K = camera
V = v cycle
X = auto Q (presses Q automatically doesnt fully work yet WIP)
right shift = open/close hub

its WIP and not accurate YET!
